winter_options.recommended_observation: one municipality territory per winter and scenario, sum only when all required original monthly outcomes observed
winter_options.proposed_transform: log1p of complete seasonal sum, not sum of monthly logarithms
winter_options.proposed_reference: immediately preceding winter, complete and ending strictly before first base-pass exposure; missing support is flagged, not silently replaced by an older winter
winter_options.alternative: winter-month model with separately validated reference and seasonality specification

profile_options.A: separate historically verified size <=20/>20 piste kilometres and summit altitude <2000/>=2000 metres; no automatic crossed classes
profile_options.B: historically verified continuous station features with simple interactions, no category cutoffs
profile_options.C: new multivariate preentry classification of existing groups; old current structural classes remain descriptive
profile_options.hotel_context_proposal: municipal accommodation in 24 months strictly before first base-pass exposure, distinct from station profile and not post-first-winter
profile_options.undated_feature_rule: no implicit stability assumption or promotion to preentry variable

multiple_exposure_options.recommended: freeze profile of all groups triggering first winter exposure; homogeneous, mixed or missing information; keep subsequent entries in network trajectory
multiple_exposure_options.alternative_joint_model: municipality-winter joint profile exposures/additions, only after separability and estimator validation
multiple_exposure_options.alternative_single_exposure: secondary restriction with separate approval and representativeness warning, never automatic
